issues.legal_issue: A High Court may not allow a second appeal under Section 100 of the Code of Civil Procedure without formulating a substantial question of law.
A second appeal that may adversely affect a party cannot be decided without properly serving that party and giving them an opportunity to be heard.
Dismissal of a special leave petition does not, by itself, bar reconsideration of a lower court order where the order is alleged to have been obtained by fraud.

The bar on a second review under Order XLVII Rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure does not prevent recall of orders alleged to have been obtained by fraud or passed in violation of the mandatory requirements governing second appeals.
